Very latency-sensitive — repeated phrase from CEO: 'sub-150ms p95 feels native, anything >300ms is noticeable'. Security/compliance: SOC2 required for vendor; SSO/SAML for admin console. No data residency requirement at this stage (NA-only customers). Legal asking about log retention and ability to disable retention for certain flows.

POC asks: 1) sample streaming demo with p95 numbers from us-east region; 2) token-cost estimate for 10k monthly messages; 3) quick checklist for SSO setup + audit logs; 4) a short guide on fallback routing to smaller/cheaper model during spikes.

Quotes: 'We need responses to feel instantaneous inside the app — streaming is non-negotiable.'
